overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works held a brief meeting in which members approved a list of contractors for city work. The meeting was extremely short, consisting of a single contractor approval vote followed by adjournment.

discussions.body: A board member made a motion to approve a list of contractors for city work, briefly pausing mid-list to correct course ('Scratch that' regarding Mavo Systems before continuing). The list included CA Excavating Construction LLC, Collard Doran Associates Inc., Eert Wrecking Inc., Firebird Construction, Hos Suns Inc., Hoser Worldwide Inc., Integrity Grading and Excavating Inc., Lineco Inc., PGA Inc., RC Pavers, Robinson Brothers Environmental, The MRD Group, Velt and Company, Waller Excavating LLC, Wolverine Construction LLC, and WS Trucking and Construction LLC. The motion was seconded and passed unanimously on a voice vote.
